    di.devregistry,
    pd.drophtm,

    pd.twistdeg,

    ((pd.drophtm / 2.0 + pd.bendforce::numeric / 100.0 + pd.twistdeg::numeric / 90.0) * pd.usbconndur::numeric / 10000.0 * 10) as ds,

WITH device_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.physregistry,
        ((pd.drophtm / 2.0 + pd.bendforce::numeric / 100.0 + pd.twistdeg::numeric / 90.0) * pd.usbconndur::numeric / 10000.0 * 10 as ds,
        CASE pd.dustres WHEN 'IPX0' THEN 0 WHEN 'IPX1' THEN 1 WHEN 'IPX2' THEN 2 WHEN 'IPX3' THEN 3 END as dustres_score,
        CASE pd.waterres WHEN 'IPX0' THEN 0 WHEN 'IPX1' THEN 1 WHEN 'IPX2' THEN 2 WHEN 'IPX3' THEN 3 END as waterres_score,
        pd.bendforce
    FROM physicaldurability pd
    JOIN interactionandcontrol ic ON ic.interactphysref = pd.physregistry
)
SELECT 
    physregistry,
    ROUND(ds, 2) as ds,
    dustres_score,
    waterres_score,
    bendforce,
    ROUND((ds * (1 + (dustres_score + waterres_score) / 6.0) * (1 - (100 - bendforce) / 200.0)), 2) as per
FROM device_metrics
WHERE (ds * (1 + (dustres_score + waterres_score) / 6.0) * (1 - (100 - bendforce) / 200.0)) > 9.0
ORDER BY per DESC
